summary: Iteration 7 spot-check of the two iteration-6 nits, per main-agent request (no full regression rerun). Backend: 6/6 new pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_fixes.py all PASS — (1) PATCH /auth/profile with {doctor_limits:{potassium_mg:1800}} persists partial limits and /me reflects it; (2) PATCH with {doctor_limits:null} explicitly clears (previously a no-op — now fixed via body.model_fields_set logic on server.py L506-514); (3) after clear, /meal-logs/summary reverts to stage-defaults 2400/1200/2300 for unknown-stage user; (4) empty-object {doctor_limits:{}} still clears (backward-compatible); (5) empty payload {} is a true no-op (both doctor_limits and diabetic preserved); (6) {diabetic:false} alone does NOT touch doctor_limits (regression guard for model_fields_set). Also re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_nutrient_budget.py — 15/15 PASS (the 3 previously-stale assertions now match the new 2400/1200/2300 unknown/pre_dialysis defaults). Frontend: registered a fresh TEST_ pre_dialysis user via API, seeded token into localStorage under keys 'renal.jwt' and '@renal.jwt' (AsyncStorage web fallback), navigated to /food/food-toor-dal — hero chip now reads 'Softened for your stage' (NOT the old 'Personalized for dialysis stage'), personalized-note KDOQI card still renders below. Switched user stage to dialysis via API and opened /food/food-atta-roti (YELLOW/PHOSPHORUS → RED tightened) — chip reads 'Tightened for your stage'. Neither old string 'Personalized for dialysis stage' nor the generic 'Personalized for your stage' appeared. Settings clear-limits: with {doctor_limits:{potassium_mg:1800}} set, settings-clear-limits was visible and settings-limits-default was hidden; after clicking clear, settings-clear-limits disappeared and settings-limits-default 'Using stage defaults' pill re-appeared, and /api/auth/me returned doctor_limits=null (server confirmed the null-payload clear worked). No red-screen, no console errors. No iteration-6 tests were re-run per main-agent instruction.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L503-518 update_profile now uses body.model_fields_set to distinguish absent vs explicit-null vs explicit-empty — clean, idiomatic Pydantic-v2 fix. Semantics: {doctor_limits:null} clears; {doctor_limits:{}} clears; {doctor_limits:{k:v}} sets partial (other fields become None); payload without 'doctor_limits' key is no-op. Verified all 4 permutations pass.

frontend/app/food/[id].tsx L94-99 dynamic label: correctly branches on personal_tier == 'GREEN' && safety_tier == 'YELLOW' → 'Softened', personal_tier == 'RED' && safety_tier == 'YELLOW' → 'Tightened', else 'Personalized for your stage'. The isPersonalized guard (L94) ensures the chip only renders when personal_tier differs from safety_tier, so the fallback 'Personalized for your stage' is effectively unreachable given current backend logic (personal_tier only ever differs on YELLOW→GREEN or YELLOW→RED) — harmless dead branch, safe future-proofing.
frontend/app/(app)/settings.tsx clearLimits calls updateProfile({doctor_limits: null}) which now correctly hits the backend clear path.
test_nutrient_budget.py assertions updated to 2400/1200/2300 for unknown-stage users — matches DEFAULT_LIMITS_BY_STAGE['unknown'] in server.py.
